summary: Round 4 verification of 5 fixes in Dynamo Feed. T1 pause freeze (mid-motion, no snap, continues from frozen value) PASSES. T1b r01 news-ticker still pauses with animation-play-state=paused — regression PASS. T2 review 3.5 stars widths settle at 100/100/100/50/0% PASS. T3 verdict stamp FAILS — its bbox overflows ~7.5px ABOVE the review-card top edge because -rotate-12 + font-size on top-2 pushes it out. T4 swipe-up hint PASS: hidden initial, appears after loop (~15s), rel_bottom≈0.76 (<0.78), above caption, hides on scroll within ~500ms. T5 SwipeDeck PARTIAL: wiggle PASS (−40→+40→0 in ~1s), grab cursor PASS, chevron opacity 0→1 on hover PASS, deck-hint 'Swipe for more' shown and hides after a commit PASS, reduced-motion skips wiggle but keeps hint PASS. However, (a) peek cards are invisible — the two aria-hidden divs have NO height class so they render as 12px/16px slivers; no visible peek below the top card. (b) deck-next click, drag past 110px, and ArrowRight all FAIL to advance the top card (title stays). deck-prev works correctly and loops back. Also now.json watch items are still REPLACE: show/film placeholders (not The Bureau / Nobody Wants This etc.).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid=review-verdict bbox extends ~7.5px above the review-card top edge (verdict.top=42.1, card.top=49.5). The -rotate-12 + text size + border-2 enlarges vertical bbox, and top-2 (8px) leaves no room. Spec requires fully INSIDE the card.

Two aria-hidden peek divs have no height class (absolute inset-x-4 top-2 ... translate-y-3 is applied but height is unset). Rendered heights are 12.5px / 11.7px — they are invisible, not peeking 8-24px below the top card as spec requires.

commit() flow is broken: setExitDir(dir) is called but no exit animation is ever started on `controls`, so onAnimationComplete never fires with an exitDir set and setIndex(v=>v+1) never runs. Result: clicking deck-next, dragging past 110px, and ArrowRight all leave the title unchanged. deck-prev works (uses setIndex directly). Fix: in commit(), after setExitDir, call `controls.start({ x: dir === 'right' ? 420 : -420, opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.35 } })` (or similar) so onAnimationComplete fires.

issues: now.json still contains placeholder values ('REPLACE: book title', 'REPLACE: show 1'..'show 3', 'REPLACE: one line on why', REPLACE author/take). Spec's expected watch order was The Bureau / Nobody Wants This / Oppenheimer / The Bear / Chernobyl. Shipping with REPLACE: strings is user-visible.

T3_verdict_inside_card.note: Verdict bbox exceeds card.top; left/right/bottom are inside. Fix top offset or rotation/transform-origin.

T5a_peek_cards.note: Rotations correct but height is tiny (empty divs with no h-* class) — no visible peek below top card.

critical_code_review_comments: SwipeDeck.commit() sets exitDir but never starts a fly-off animation via `controls.start(...)`. onAnimationComplete therefore never fires with exitDir!=null and setIndex never advances. Add an explicit exit animate call inside commit (or inside a useEffect that watches exitDir).
The two peek <div aria-hidden> elements inside [data-testid=swipe-deck] have no height class; use `h-full` plus a positive translate-y to make them peek below the top card by ~8-24px.
ReviewTemplate verdict is positioned at top-2 with -rotate-12. The rotated bbox exceeds the card top by ~7.5px. Increase top to top-3/top-4 or add explicit transform-origin + reduce rotate magnitude.
src/content/now.json is still filled with REPLACE: ... placeholders. Ship real values for user-facing cards (now reading + watch deck + spanish streak etc.).

success_rate.frontend: ~75% (10/13 sub-checks pass; verdict stamp + peek cards + forward navigation fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: DOM scoping gotchas: (a) feed slots are data-testid=feed-slot-{i} not feed-slot. (b) swipe-hint lives at [data-testid=feed-frame] level, NOT inside the active slot — scope hint queries to feed-frame. (c) the breaking_news slug is `breaking-built-by-voice` (NOT `breaking-tech-shutdown`). Reels shuffle per load so always deep-link /r/<slug> and resolve active slot via feed-scroller.scrollTop ≈ slot.offsetTop. For wiggle polling: card translate X reaches ≈-40 at ~0.3s and +40 at ~0.6s post deck-visible (observed 300-800ms range in this run) and returns to 0 by ~1s; poll 50ms over ≥2s. deck-prev works via setIndex directly; deck-next/drag/ArrowRight share the broken commit() flow — any fix should re-test those three paths.

rca_of_the_issue.deck_forward_navigation: In SwipeDeck.tsx the commit() handler calls controls.stop(); setExitDir(dir); but never calls controls.start(...) to launch the fly-off. motion.div's onAnimationComplete only triggers when a controls-driven animation finishes; after stop() there is no running animation, so onAnimationComplete never fires with exitDir!=null and index is never incremented. deck-prev works because it uses setIndex directly without relying on the exit animation.
rca_of_the_issue.peek_cards_invisible: The two aria-hidden peek divs have classes `absolute inset-x-4 top-2 -rotate-3 translate-y-3` with no height — they collapse to zero (visible dims ~12px). They need h-full (or an absolute bottom) to actually peek below the top card.
rca_of_the_issue.verdict_stamp_overflow: Verdict uses -rotate-12 which rotates the stamp 12°, enlarging its vertical bounding box by ~sin(12)*width ≈ 32px. With only top-2 (8px) breathing room inside p-4 card padding, the top edge of the rotated bbox lands ~7.5px above card.top. Increase top offset or reduce rotation to keep bbox inside.
